200.description: One page of the run history, newest first.

snapshotAsOf.description: The planning-facts watermark the pass planned from; absent on a FAILED run that never reached a watermark.

failClosedReason.description: The fail-closed snapshot refusal; present only when outcome is FAILED.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

type.description: Stable machine-readable problem identifier, an absolute URI of the form https://warehouse.example/problems/<kind> (for example .../transfer-not-found).
